quest.title: Hammer and Wrench
quest.description: Wrench Wang from Liyue Harbor seems to be looking for help with some matters...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: I suppose I should give him a Xiao Lantern after all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give who a Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler, it's you. Well, "The Wrench" has always taken good care of me. Even now, he helps me out all the time — he's almost like a real brother to me.

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: This is supposed to be a festival, and yet he's still working non-stop...

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: So, I'd like to give him a Xiao Lantern as a gift. Hehe, we were childhood playmates, and he absolutely loved the sight of the lanterns when he was little.

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: I'm sure he'd love to get one now. Traveler, could you help me deliver this Xiao Lantern to him?

choices.text: Don't you want to give it to him yourself?

response.speaker: Siyu
response.text: I'd love to, but I've still got so many things to take care of at home...

response.speaker: Siyu
response.text: I've left my husband to do all the housework while I've been out shopping. I should get back to help him out as soon as I can.

response.speaker: Siyu
response.text: So I'm leaving the matter of the Xiao Lantern to you. Once we've got some time, my husband and I will go see "The Wrench" together.

response.speaker: Siyu
response.text: I do hope that he'll manage to get a little more free time...

choices.text: It might mean more coming from you...

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Wrench Wang

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you have some business with me, Traveler? I'm quite busy at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's a Xiao Lantern from Siyu...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Siyu? She... she got me a Xiao Lantern? L—Let me see!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hahaha, she wrote this wish for me, didn't she? Yep, that was my greatest wish as a kid...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: So many years have passed in the blink of an eye. Time truly flies...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Still, how come she asked you to deliver it to me?

choices.text: She has things to attend to at home...

response.speaker: Wrench Wang
response.text: Ah, is that so... Good, good. Yes. Very good.

response.speaker: Wrench Wang
response.text: Sounds like she's got a good life now. That's all that matters... Haha... Heh.

response.speaker: Wrench Wang
response.text: It's a good thing. It's very good... I'm sorry, I've still got a lot of work to do. If you'll please excuse me...

choices.text: She needs to return home to help her husband...

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: That Xiao Lantern was from Siyu, wasn't it?

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: Hah, I just know him well enough. There was no need to even guess.

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: He did exactly the same thing last year. Went off for a walk, then came right back and proceeded to hammer nails into a ship's hull the whole night through.

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: I know why he does this, but still... *sigh*

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: Traveler, could you please go help him out? Tormenting oneself is no way to spend a festival...

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: I bet he's onboard a ship right now, working away... Best you go find him quick.

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: I'll be preparing some food in a bit. Come back here once you're done and we'll eat together.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: We've dallied so long, I'm sure we've fallen behind on work. Best we put our backs into it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Y—You sure you're alright?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hey! What are you trying to say? I'm fine! Why wouldn't I be?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: I should get back to work now. Once I've finished... *sigh* Well, I'll see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me to help.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hmm? ...Well, if you really want to, you can bring me some wooden planks.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Have you brought the planks?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Mm, these should do the trick. Many thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: There's still a few loose ends to tie up. Could I trouble you to go to the dock and take inventory of some newly arrived goods?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: There should be a total of three crates piled up at the dock.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: You're a big help. In the meantime, I need to get a move on and finish up everything here...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Have you tallied the numbers up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All done.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Thank you very much!

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Well then! That's today's urgent work dealt with.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hammer Li says he's got some food prepped for you.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Huh? Does he, now? ...That guy worries too much.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Since he's already gone to the trouble of making it, let's go and join him.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Besides, you helped me out a lot too, so some of that should go to you as compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: It's done. I hope I didn't keep you waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Oh, you've finished everything?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Aye. It was a small matter, and with this traveler helping, it was easy.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: You... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Oh, come on. It's the festive season, no need for the long face.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Yes, sure, whatever you say. Have you prepared a Xiao Lantern yet?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: A Xiao Lantern... Ugh, I forgot! What's with my memory today...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Ah well, never mind, eh? It's just a lantern. So what if we don't release one this time?

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Hah, don't you try that with me. You're not seriously suggesting that we celebrate the Lantern Rite without a lantern, now, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you make a lantern for my colleague ?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. We'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Did you bring the Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: That will do. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: You've really done a lot, Traveler, and during the festive period, too...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Well then, what should I wish for...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hmm, let's go with this: "New year, new horizons!"

response.speaker: Wrench Wang
response.text: You think so? Hahaha, that's good... Ah, I do wish that it would come true...

response.speaker: Hammer Li
response.text: He made the same wish last year as well...

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: I do hope that "The Wrench" will like this Xiao Lantern...

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why does he choose to suffer like this...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: I don't really need a Xiao Lantern, honestly, I...

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Oh, come on. It's the Lantern Rite. Let's release a lantern and get some of that festive joy in you.
